ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What are the sharp pointy teeth called?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is a labeled diagram of an open mouth/teeth structure, with guide lines and text labels around it. On the right side, tooth-related labels can be seen, including Central incisor, Lateral incisor, Canine, Molars, Premolars, among which the guide line for “Canine” points to the relatively pointed tooth beside the incisors. Then reason: the question asks what “sharp pointy teeth” are called; the pointed teeth in the image correspond to the label “Canine.”
